description: Pipeline Events Timeline — shows the sequence of events during workflow generation, including phase durations, token usage, and validation error changes, helping developers understand and debug the generation pipeline.

target.label: Required element for Pipeline Events Timeline

Required element 1 for state Per-Event Metrics

groups.description: Users need to see per-event metrics including duration in milliseconds, token counts, and validation error deltas to identify bottlenecks and measure improvement.

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Timeline Behavior
assertions.precondition: More events exist than fit in the max-h-96 container

assertions.description: Required element 1 for state Timeline Behavior
assertions.precondition: More events exist than fit in the max-h-96 container

groups.description: The timeline is scrollable when events exceed the visible area (max-h-96), events are ordered chronologically by created_at, and the timeline connector lines visually link sequential events.
groups.name: Timeline Behavior

assertions.description: Required element 0 for state Required Timeline Elements

target.label: Required element for Required Timeline Elements

groups.description: Each event row must contain a phase color dot, event type label, and timeline connector line. The header must show the Zap icon.
groups.name: Required Timeline Elements

assertions.precondition: More than 50 pipeline events exist for the task run

assertions.precondition: More than 50 pipeline events exist for the task run

target.label: Required element for Virtualized Rendering and Pagination

assertions.description: Required element 2 for state Virtualized Rendering and Pagination
assertions.precondition: More than 50 pipeline events exist for the task run

target.label: Required element for Virtualized Rendering and Pagination

groups.description: The Pipeline Events timeline uses react-window virtualized rendering to handle large event lists efficiently. Events are paginated client-side (50 per page) with a 'Load more' button. The header shows a count indicator like '50 of 8297'. Only visible event rows plus a 10-row overscan buffer are rendered in the DOM.
groups.name: Virtualized Rendering and Pagination
